fusions.name: Ballast Shot
fusions.desc: Slings a heavy weight that deals 8 damage. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Ironclad Ram
fusions.desc: A heavy blow that deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your armour rises 15%.

fusions.name: Unbowed
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Deadweight
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 4% sooner. Your armour rises by 20%.
